author: Discovery
description:
Explore these ghost towns and their haunting stories, from Cerro Gordo, marked by violent mining deaths and tragic hotel fires, to Jerome, plagued by mining disasters and hospital deaths. In Tombstone, echoes of Wild West gunfights still linger, while Goodsprings is said to harbor restless mining and mob-era spirits, along with countless other chilling legends.
